Thanks for the ping. Quick read-through — good first pass. A few compliance asks before we finalize PO/payment setup: 

1) W-8BEN-E: We need the line that indicates chapter 3/status clearly completed (they should unambiguously check Part I, line 3 and relevant Chapter 3/4 claim boxes). If they're not claiming treaty benefits, that's OK — just confirm.
2) UBO evidence: the signed UBO declaration is acceptable as starter evidence, but for EU corporate vendors we usually require a Registro Imprese extract (company registry) dated within the last 3 months to corroborate legal name and registration number. Please request that from Solvento.
3) Bank confirmation: the DocuSign bank confirmation letter is ideal — once returned, finance will perform an IBAN validation and a small micro-deposit test if needed for SEPA.
4) ID redaction: redact passport numbers on the UBO doc (they've already indicated they'll redact, good).

Action items for procurement (Ava): please ask Elena for a Registro Imprese extract (recent), and ask them to explicitly confirm whether Solvento is claiming any US tax treaty benefits on the W-8BEN-E. Once we have registry + bank letter we'll greenlight PO creation (keeping the PO status "Pending Documents").

If any of this is a timing issue for the vendor, we can issue a conditional PO tied to confirmation of final docs, but payments will be blocked until docs are validated.

Karthik
Director, Tax & Compliance
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
